description: Structured-first hybrid search across analyst views + news (views weighted higher). Three lanes — entity (company codes / names, analyst names), concept-graph hub (theme alias → concept → constituents & research), and full-text keyword matching (Chinese word-segmented) — fused with RRF. Deterministic & explainable: no vector kNN, no LLM rerank. Best for theme/concept queries: 'CPO' brings out 光模块/光通信/光芯片; '减肥药' brings out 创新药; '智驾' brings out 智能驾驶. Use `news` or `views` instead if you need strict time-window listing.

_fields.description: 逗号分隔的直接字段；有 items 时投影每行，否则投影 data；外层字段或嵌套结构用 _jq

_intent.description: 用户原问题一句话，仅分析用，可留空

_jq.description: JMESPath，对 data 求值（写 items[*].id）

_max_bytes.description: 响应字节上限，默认约 50 KB

_max_bytes_mode.description: 正文超限处理，默认 truncate 保留前缀

_spill.description: true=全量落盘，只回摘要与取数地址

hours.description: Lookback window in hours; omit for no time limit

mode.description: hybrid = entity + concept-graph + full-text fused; exact = keyword full-text only

name: search
